children: CBOT December wheat (WZ26) may retest a resistance at $7.28 per bushel, a break above which may lead to a gain into the $7.33-3/4 to $7.37-1/2 range.
The contract managed to stabilized around a support at $7.12-3/4 again. The stabilization suggests the formation of a bottom, which will be confirmed when the market breaks $7.33-3/4.
It is not very clear that the market could resume its rise around a support at $7.23-1/4, or retrace further toward $7.18-1/2 before rising.

On the daily chart, the contract is stuck in a narrow range of $7.13-3/4 to $7.30. An escape would suggest a direction. The bias might be toward the upside, as the correction from $7.95 might be the same degree as the one from $7.28-1/4.
A rising channel indicates a completion of the current fall around $7.13-3/4, to be followed by a continuation of the uptrend.
